sources.mainSiteWorld: assets/css/style.css (dark graphite; only shared constants recorded)

display.purpose: Hero H1 only. Archivo 800, 112% width, uppercase, balanced; fitted to three lines from 1280px.

headline.purpose: Section H2s (except the FAQ title) and the thanks title. Archivo 800, 112% width, uppercase. Service titles, panel titles and the Larger-Scope title use the same voice at smaller sizes.

title.purpose: H3s for scope rows, pillars, steps and Larger-Scope rows; FAQ questions. Archivo 700, 106% width, sentence case.

body.purpose: All reading copy. Figtree 400, 17px (16.5px under 760px), leads capped at 58ch.

label.purpose: Button text and functional labels. Archivo 700, 116% width, uppercase, tracked 0.1em to 0.2em.

faq-title.purpose: The one section H2 in title case: Archivo 800, 112% width, clamp(2.3rem, 4.7vw, 4.1rem), line height 1; may be held on one line (phones min(2.3rem, 8.2vw)).

shadows.name: field-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Thickens the ink border of a focused input. The only shadow in the landing world.

shadows.name: field-error-ring
shadows.purpose: Thickens the border of an input in error.

frames.name: brass-frame
frames.purpose: Inset brass profile on hero and feature photos.

frames.name: brass-frame-hover
frames.value: inset 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(211, 173, 135, 0.9); fades in from scale(1.03)

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: House ease for every transition (shared with the main site).

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Button, field and option color and border changes.

motion.name: frame-draw
motion.purpose: Hero brass frame draws once on load.

motion.name: gallery-loop
motion.purpose: Looping gallery rows; paused on hover or focus, stopped under reduced motion.

motion.name: chooser-hover
motion.purpose: Room chooser tile inverts to graphite.

narrative.overview:
LCG Boston is one brand expressed in two worlds. The main site (`assets/css/style.css`) is a dark graphite world. Service landing pages (`assets/css/lp.css`, shared by every service LP: bathroom, kitchen, and the combined kitchen and bathroom LP) are built like a finished shower: a pale, warm honed-stone ground, graphite bands, and a slim 1px bronze profile that frames each important plane. Both worlds share the same constants: the official LCG mark, bronze, graphite, the Archivo plus Figtree pair, square geometry, and plain, factual copy. This document records the shared constants and the service-landing-page world in full. The dark main-site world is not redocumented here beyond what it shares.

The landing world is calm and editorial rather than loud. Reading happens on stone in graphite ink; the header, the partner section, the estimate section and the footer drop into graphite to give the page structure. Bronze is used as metal, never as paint over large areas: a 1px inset profile on photographs, square markers, thin rules, the progress bar, and the one solid fill it is allowed, the primary action. Real project photography carries the proof, cropped tall and framed rather than darkened or overlaid with text.

Density is generous on desktop (sections of 72 to 136px) and compact but never cramped on mobile, where a fixed graphite action bar keeps Call and Free Estimate one tap away.
keyCharacteristics: Light warm stone ground, graphite bands, bronze as a 1px brass profile.
Archivo expanded uppercase for headings and actions; Figtree for reading.
Square corners everywhere (2px on controls, 0 on panels and photos).
Flat: depth from tonal bands and hairline rules, not shadows.
Real photography framed by an inset brass line; no overlays, no stock.
One action per screen in bronze; calling is the quieter alternative.

rules.name: The Brass Profile Rule
rules.body: Bronze is a line before it is a fill. Photos, lists, form sections and the process rail get a 1px bronze profile; only the primary action is solid bronze.

rules.name: The Readable Metal Rule
rules.body: Bronze text or icons on stone use Bronze Text, never brand bronze. Brand bronze is for fills, lines, and icons on graphite.

rules.name: The Built Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for expanded Archivo: headings, actions and functional labels. Reading copy is always Figtree in sentence case. The FAQ title is the one heading set in title case; it is an exception, not a second heading style.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Phone numbers, ZIP inputs and process numbers use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat Stone Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows on cards, panels, photos or buttons. To lift a surface, step its tone or rule it with a hairline.

dos: **Do** use the official logo files from `assets/img/brand/` as supplied (the bronze lockup on graphite), never redrawn or recolored.
**Do** keep every corner square: 2px on controls, 0 on panels, photos and joins.
**Do** frame real project photos with the 1px inset brass line instead of overlays or gradients.
**Do** use Bronze Text (`bronze-text`) for bronze icons and text on stone; reserve brand bronze for fills, lines and graphite contexts.
**Do** pair every primary action with the call link as the quieter alternative.
**Do** write all shipped copy in American English without em dashes.
**Do** keep focus visible: a 2px ink outline on light, Polished Bronze inside graphite regions.
**Do** honor reduced motion: the brass-frame draw and photo settle are skipped, transitions collapse.
donts: **Don't** fill large areas with bronze; the primary action is its only solid surface.
**Don't** add drop shadows to cards, panels, photos or buttons; step the tone or add a hairline.
**Don't** set reading copy in uppercase or in Archivo; Figtree carries all running text.
**Don't** use rounded corners or pill shapes on any control.
**Don't** use glyph or emoji icons; icons are inline SVG strokes with square caps.
**Don't** present several photos of the same room as separate projects in the gallery.
